info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Funds Confirmation Consent Management API
info.description: The Funds Confirmation Consent Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage consent for funds confirmation requests. It allows authorized users to revoke specific consents previously granted by customers, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations and enhancing user control over personal information. Utilized primarily by application developers at banks and fintech companies, this API streamlines consent management processes within open banking ecosystems, supporting secure interactions between consumers and service providers.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specific funds confirmation consent identified by the provided resource identifier. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a funds confirmation consent identified by the unique reference RES-100045. Ensure that the request is made with the proper authorization before attempting to delete the consent.
